title: Savdo va muzokara asoslari
goal_uz: Dars oxirida siz inglizcha oddiy savdolashuvlarda ehtiyoj va chegaralaringizni aniq bayon qilasiz, taklif va qarshi-taklif berasiz, shartli takliflar (if… then) tuzasiz, muloyim norozilik bildirasiz va kelishuvni professional yopasiz.
homework_uz: Yozma dialogda narx muzokara qiling: ikki kishi o‘rtasida kamida olti replika — ehtiyoj ('We need…'), taklif, qarshi-taklif, bitta shartli ibora ('If you can…, then we can…'), 'give and get' almashinuvi va yakunda 'We have a deal' hamda yozma tasdiq va’di berilsin. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: dialog to‘liq inglizchada, har replika aniq, ovoz chiqarib o‘qilganda bir yarim-ikki daqiqa davom etadi. Keyingi dars: P1-10 Sayohat: aeroport va mehmonxona.

vocab.uz: ehtiyoj va chegaralar (nima kerak, nima mumkin emas)
eng oxirgi, bundan pastga tushilmaydigan pozitsiya
qarshi-taklif — raqam yoki shart bilan javob
yon berish — narx yoki shartlarda bir qadam
kelishuvdan chiqib ketish ('We'll have to walk away')

vocab.w: If you can…, then we can…
vocab.uz: shartli taklif formulasi — shart birinchi, natija keyin

scenes.title: Savdo va muzokaraga xush kelibsiz
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! O‘tgan darsda mijozlar bilan ishlashni o‘rgandik — salomlashish, shikoyat va muloyim rad etish. Bugun esa savdo va muzokara: ehtiyojingizni aniq bayon qilasiz, taklif va qarshi-taklif berasiz, shartli taklif tuzasiz va kelishuvni yakunlaysiz. Dars oxirida siz oddiy bitimni inglizcha ishonch bilan yopib olasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome! Last lesson was customer service — greeting, complaints, polite refusal. Today: sales and negotiation. You'll state your needs, make offers and counter-offers, use conditional proposals and close the deal — all in English.
scenes.say_uz: Assalomu alaykum! O‘tgan darsda mijozlar bilan ishlash — salomlashish, shikoyat va muloyim rad etishni o‘rgandik. Bugun: savdo va muzokara. Siz ehtiyojingizni bayon qilasiz, taklif va qarshi-taklif berasiz, shartli taklif tuzasiz va bitimni yakunlaysiz — barchasini inglizcha.

scenes.title: Muzokaraning 4 bosqichi

examples.t: Discover first, then offer — never the other way round.
examples.uz: Avval aniqlang, keyin taklif bering — aksincha emas.

scenes.say_native: Har muzokara to‘rt bosqichdan iborat. Birinchisi — Discover: kim nimani xohlayotganini va nima uchunligini aniqlash; ikki tomonning ehtiyoji bilinmasa, taklif qilishga shoshilmang. Ikkinchisi — Offer: o‘z taklifingizni aniq raqam yoki shartlar bilan aytasiz. Uchinchisi — Counter: qarshi-takliflar almashinuvi, eng ko‘p vaqt shu yerda o‘tadi. To‘rtinchisi — Close: yakuniy shartlarni takrorlab, kelishuvni tasdiqlaysiz.
scenes.say: Every negotiation has four stages. Discover: find out what the other side actually needs. Offer: state your terms in numbers. Counter: the exchange of counter-offers — this is where most time is spent. Close: repeat the final terms and confirm the deal.
scenes.say_uz: Har muzokara to‘rt bosqichdan iborat. Discover — ikki tomon nima xohlayotganini aniqlash. Offer — shartlaringizni raqamlarda aytish. Counter — qarshi-takliflar almashinuvi, eng ko‘p vaqt shu yerda o‘tadi. Close — yakuniy shartlarni takrorlab, bitimni tasdiqlash.

scenes.title: Needs: ehtiyojni raqam bilan ayting

examples.t: We need two hundred chairs by 15 June, and our budget is about eight thousand dollars.
examples.uz: Bizga o‘n besh iyungacha ikki yuz stul kerak, byudjetimiz taxminan sakkiz ming dollar.

scenes.say_native: Needs — ehtiyojlar. Inglizcha muzokarada ehtiyojni to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri aytasiz: 'We need the goods by March', 'Our budget is around five thousand', 'We can't go above ten percent'. 'Maybe', 'we'll see', 'it depends' kabi noaniq gaplar — sizning ishonchsizligingizning belgisi. Ehtiyojni raqam va muddat bilan ayting: miqdor, narx, sana. O‘zbekcha muzokarada ham shunday — 'besh mingdan oshmaydi' qat’iy chegara, 'keyinroq ko‘ramiz' emas.
scenes.say: State needs in numbers: 'We need the goods by March', 'Our budget is around five thousand', 'We can't go above ten percent'. Vague phrases like 'maybe' or 'we'll see' signal insecurity. Quantity, price, deadline — always.
scenes.say_uz: Ehtiyojni raqam bilan ayting: 'We need the goods by March', 'Our budget is around five thousand', 'We can't go above ten percent'. 'Maybe' va 'we'll see' kabi noaniq gaplar — ishonchsizlik belgisi. Miqdor, narx, muddat — har doim.

scenes.title: Namuna: ehtiyojni bayon qilish
scenes.say_native: Namuna ehtiyojni bayon qilishni o‘qing: mijoz avval nima kerakligini, keyin miqdorni, keyin byudjet va muddatni aytadi. E’tibor bering — u 'maybe' yoki 'we think' demiayapti, qat’iy va aniq. Shunday bayonot sotuvchiga jiddiy xaridor ekaningizni ko‘rsatadi va taklifni tezlashtiradi.
scenes.say: Good morning. We need two hundred office chairs delivered by the end of June. Our budget is around eight thousand dollars, and we pay by invoice. If you can meet those terms, we'd like to place the order today.
scenes.say_uz: Xayrli tong. Bizga ikki yuzta ofis stuli kerak, iyun oxirigacha yetkazib berilgan holda. Byudjetimiz taxminan sakkiz ming dollar, to‘lovni hisob-faktura orqali amalga oshiramiz. Shu shartlarga mossa bo‘lsangiz, bugunyoq buyurtma bermoqchimiz.

scenes.title: Limits: bottom line nima
board: 'That's as low as we can go.'

examples.t: Our bottom line is eight thousand — we can't stretch beyond that.
examples.uz: Eng past chegaramiz — sakkiz ming, bundan ortiq uzaytira olmaymiz.

scenes.say_native: Limit — chegara. O‘ylang: eng oxirgi qabul qiladigan narx yoki shartingiz nima? Inglizcha: 'Our bottom line is eight thousand' — bundan pastga tushmaymiz. 'We can't stretch that far' — bunchalik uzaytira olmaymiz. 'That's as low as we can go' — bundan arzonga tusholmaymiz. Muhim: chegarangizni ichingizda bilib oling, lekin hamma narsani oshkor qilmang — muzokarada strategiya muhim, hammasi ochiq bo‘lmaydi.
scenes.say: Know your limit before the talk starts. 'Our bottom line is eight thousand.' 'We can't stretch that far.' 'That's as low as we can go.' Keep the number in your head — revealing everything hands the other side the advantage.
scenes.say_uz: Chegarangizni suhbatdan oldin bilib oling. 'Our bottom line is eight thousand.' 'We can't stretch that far.' 'That's as low as we can go.' Raqamni ichingizda saqlang — hamma narsani ochish ikkinchi tomonga ustunlik beradi.

scenes.title: Ehtiyojni bayon qiling
scenes.say_native: Endi ehtiyojni bayon qiling. Tasavvur qiling: ofisingiz uchun o‘n beshta noutbuk kerak, sentabrgacha, byudjet ellik ming dollar. 'We need…' bilan boshlang, miqdor va sanani ayting, byudjetni qo‘shing va oxirida 'If you can meet these terms…' deb tugating. Ovoz chiqarib, yigirma soniyada aytib bering.
scenes.say: State your needs aloud. Scenario: fifteen laptops for your office, needed by September, budget around fifty thousand dollars. Start with 'We need…', add quantity, deadline and budget. Twenty seconds.
scenes.say_uz: Ehtiyojingizni ovoz chiqarib ayting. Vaziyat: ofisingiz uchun o‘n besh noutbuk, sentabrgacha kerak, byudjet taxminan ellik ming dollar. 'We need…' bilan boshlang, miqdor, sana va byudjetni qo‘shing. Yigirma soniya.

scenes.title: Anchoring: birinchi taklifning kuchi

examples.t: We'd like to start at twelve thousand, given the volume.
examples.uz: Hajm sababli o‘n ikki mingdan boshlamoqchimiz.

scenes.say_native: Anchoring — muzokaraning kuchli psixologik effekti: birinchi aytilgan raqam suhbat markazi bo‘ladi. Birinchi taklif qilgan tomon ustun bo‘ladi — agar raqam asosli bo‘lsa. Taktika ochlik emas: 'Around twelve thousand' deb boshlab, asta-sekin tushsangiz, ikkinchi tomon g‘oliblik hissini oladi — va siz maqsadingizga yaqinlashasiz.
scenes.say: The first number said out loud becomes the anchor for everything after it. Open with a strong but fair figure: 'We'd like to start at twelve thousand, given the volume.' If you concede later, the other side feels they won — and you still land near your target.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi ovoz bilan aytilgan raqam keyingi hamma narsa uchun mo‘ljal bo‘ladi. Kuchli, lekin adolatli oching: 'We'd like to start at twelve thousand, given the volume.' Keyinroq yon bersangiz, ikkinchi tomon g‘oliblik hissini oladi — va siz baribir maqsadingizga yaqinlashasiz.

scenes.title: Offers: uch xil taklif formulasi

examples.t: We can offer a unit price of fifty with delivery included.
examples.uz: Yetkazib berish bilan birga birligiga ellik dollar taklif qila olamiz.

scenes.say_native: Taklif berish inglizchasida uch asosiy formula bor. 'We can offer ten thousand dollars' — to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri, ishonchli. 'We'd like to propose a unit price of fifty' — rasmiy va muloyim. 'How about eight thousand with free delivery?' — so‘roq ko‘rinishidagi yumshoq taklif. Har taklifda raqam va shart bo‘lsin — faqat 'we can do something' yetarli emas; ikkinchi tomon nima, qancha va qachon ekanini bilishi kerak.
scenes.say: Three offer patterns: 'We can offer ten thousand.' 'We'd like to propose a unit price of fifty.' 'How about eight thousand with free delivery?' Every offer needs a number and a condition — the other side must know what, how much and when.
scenes.say_uz: Uchta taklif formulasi: 'We can offer ten thousand.' 'We'd like to propose a unit price of fifty.' 'How about eight thousand with free delivery?' Har taklifda raqam va shart bo‘lsin — ikkinchi tomon nima, qancha va qachon ekanini bilishi kerak.

scenes.title: Namuna: ochiq taklif
scenes.say_native: Namuna ochiq taklifni o‘qing: sotuvchi miqdor, narx, to‘lov shartlari va muddatni bir nafasda aytadi. Bunda 'around' va 'about' ishlatilmagan — aniq raqamlar. E’tibor bering: taklif yakunida 'Does that work for you?' so‘rog‘i bor — bu suhbatni ikki tomonlama qiladi, hisobot emas, dialog bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: For two hundred chairs, we can offer a unit price of forty dollars, which comes to eight thousand total, with delivery included and payment within thirty days. Does that work for you?
scenes.say_uz: Ikki yuz stulga birligiga qirq dollar taklif qila olamiz, bu jami sakkiz ming dollar — yetkazib berish bepul, to‘lov o‘ttiz kun ichida. Sizga mos keladimi?

scenes.title: Counter-offers: qarshi-taklif san’ati

examples.t: That's a bit high for us — could you do seven thousand?
examples.uz: Bu biz uchun biroz qimmat — yetti mingga topa olamizmi?

scenes.say_native: Qarshi-taklifda uch ibora yetadi. 'That's a bit high for us' — yumshoq norozilik, janjal emas. 'Could you do seven thousand?' — to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri qarshi raqam. 'How about eight thousand with free delivery?' — muqobil shart bilan. Ohang professional bo‘lsin: noroziligingizni raqam yoki shart bilan ifodalang, hissiyot bilan emas. 'That's too expensive!' kabi gaplar muzokarani buzadi va ikkinchi tomonni himoyaga o‘tkazadi.
scenes.say: Three counter-offer tools: 'That's a bit high for us.' 'Could you do seven thousand?' 'How about eight thousand with free delivery?' Express your doubt in numbers, not emotions — 'That's too expensive!' puts the other side on the defensive.
scenes.say_uz: Uchta qarshi-taklif quroli: 'That's a bit high for us.' 'Could you do seven thousand?' 'How about eight thousand with free delivery?' Shubhangizni raqam bilan ifodalang, hissiyot bilan emas — 'That's too expensive!' ikkinchi tomonni himoyaga o‘tkazadi.

scenes.title: Shartli takliflar: if… then

examples.t: If you deliver by Friday, then we can increase the order.
examples.uz: Agar juma kuni yetkazib bersangiz, buyurtmani oshira olamiz.

scenes.say_native: Shartli taklif — muzokaraning eng yopiq shakli: siz berasiz, agar ular bersa. Inglizcha: 'If you can deliver by Friday, then we can increase the order', 'If the price drops to seven, then we can pay in advance'. Rasmiy variant — 'provided that': 'We accept, provided that payment terms stay at thirty days'. Qoida oddiy: shart doim birinchi, natija keyin — avval 'if', keyin 'then'. Tartibni almashtirmang.
scenes.say: The conditional proposal is the closed form of bargaining: you give, if they give. 'If you can deliver by Friday, then we can increase the order.' Formal variant: 'We accept, provided that payment terms stay at thirty days.' Condition first, result second — always.
scenes.say_uz: Shartli taklif — savdolanishning yopiq shakli: siz berasiz, agar ular bersa. 'If you can deliver by Friday, then we can increase the order.' Rasmiy variant: 'We accept, provided that payment terms stay at thirty days.' Shart doim birinchi, natija keyin — har doim.

scenes.title: Namuna: shartli taklif dialogi
scenes.say_native: Namunadagi shartli tuzilmani kuzating: avval shart ('If you can include…'), keyin natija ('…then we can confirm…'). Ikkinchi shartli jumla — 'Alternatively, if the price stays at forty…' — zaxira variant. Ikki tomon ham nima olishini va nima berishini aniq biladi; shunday dialoglar eng tez yopiladi.
scenes.say: If you can include free delivery and reduce the price to thirty-eight dollars per unit, then we can confirm the order today and pay half up front. Alternatively, if the price stays at forty, we'd need net-sixty payment terms.
scenes.say_uz: Agar yetkazib berishni bepul qo‘shib, narxni birligiga o‘ttiz sakkiz dollarga tushirsangiz, bugunyoq buyurtmani tasdiqlab, yarmini oldindan to‘laymiz. Aks holda narx qirqda qolsa, to‘lov muddati oltmish kun bo‘lishi kerak.

scenes.title: Qarshi-taklif yozing
scenes.say_native: Qarshi-taklifni ovoz chiqarib ayting. Vaziyat: sotuvchi stulga birligiga qirq besh dollar taklif qildi, byudjetingiz qirq. 'That's a bit high for us' deb boshlang, 'Could you do forty?' deb raqam ayting va oxirida shart qo‘shing: 'If you can do forty, then we can double the order.' Yigirma besh soniya, ovoz chiqarib.
scenes.say: Speak the counter-offer. Seller quoted forty-five per chair; your budget is forty. Start with 'That's a bit high for us', name your number, and add an 'if…then' sweetener. Twenty-five seconds, out loud.
scenes.say_uz: Qarshi-taklifni ayting. Sotuvchi stulga birligiga qirq besh dollar taklif qildi, byudjetingiz qirq. 'That's a bit high for us' bilan boshlang, raqamingizni ayting va 'if…then' shakarini qo‘shing. Yigirma besh soniya, ovoz chiqarib.

scenes.title: Chegirma so‘rash: volume discount
board: 'What discount can you offer for bulk?'

examples.t: If we increase the order to five hundred units, what discount can you offer?
examples.uz: Agar buyurtmani besh yuztagacha oshirsak, qanday chegirma berasiz?

scenes.say_native: Chegirma so‘rash inglizchasi: 'What discount can you offer for bulk orders?' — hajm evaziga. 'Is there room for negotiation on the price?' — umumiy so‘rov. 'We'd expect a volume discount' — kutishni bildirish. Chegirma so‘raganda har doim evaziga nima berishingizni ayting: hajm, tez to‘lov, uzoq muddatli shartnoma. Bepul chegirma yo‘q — har bir chegirmaning narxi bo‘ladi va uni siz to‘laysiz.
scenes.say: How to ask: 'What discount can you offer for bulk orders?' 'Is there room for negotiation on the price?' 'We'd expect a volume discount.' Always name what you give in return — volume, fast payment, a longer contract. There is no free discount.
scenes.say_uz: So‘rash usullari: 'What discount can you offer for bulk orders?' 'Is there room for negotiation on the price?' 'We'd expect a volume discount.' Har doim evaziga nimani berishingizni ayting — hajm, tez to‘lov, uzoq shartnoma. Bepul chegirma yo‘q.

scenes.title: Concessions: give and get

examples.t: If we pay within seven days, could you reduce the price by five percent?
examples.uz: Yetti kun ichida to‘lasak, narxni besh foizga tushira olasizmi?

scenes.say_native: Bosh hisobsiz yon berish — muzokaraning eng qimmat xatosi. Har chegirma evaziga nimadir oling: 'If we pay within seven days, could you reduce the price by five percent?' — tez to‘lov evaziga narx. 'If we increase the order to five hundred units, could you give us free delivery?' — hajm evaziga xizmat. 'Give and get' tamoyili oddiy: siz bersangiz, ular ham beradi. Bir tomonli yon berishlar keyin sizni zaif ko‘rsatadi.
scenes.say: Never concede for nothing. 'If we pay within seven days, could you reduce the price by five percent?' 'If we increase the order to five hundred units, could you give us free delivery?' Give and get — one for one. One-sided concessions make you look weak.
scenes.say_uz: Bosh hisobsiz yon bermang. 'If we pay within seven days, could you reduce the price by five percent?' 'If we increase the order to five hundred units, could you give us free delivery?' Give and get — bitta-bittaga. Bir tomonlama yon berish sizni zaif ko‘rsatadi.

scenes.title: Meet halfway: farqni teng ikkiga

examples.t: You're at twelve, we're at ten — shall we meet halfway at eleven?
examples.uz: Siz o‘n ikki deyapsiz, biz o‘n — o‘n birdan o‘rtada uchrashak qolsinmi?

scenes.say_native: 'Meet halfway' va 'split the difference' — farqni ikkiga bo‘lish taklifi. Siz o‘n ming, ular o‘n ikki ming taklif qilsa: 'Shall we meet halfway at eleven thousand?' Ikkalangiz ham to‘liq yutmaysiz, to‘liq yutqazmaysiz. Lekin shuni yodda tuting: farq kichik bo‘lganda ishlaydi. Agar ular ellik ming, siz o‘n ming aytsangiz, 'o‘rtachasi' hech kimga ma’qul emas — takliflar oldin bir-biriga yaqinlashishi kerak.
scenes.say: 'Shall we meet halfway?' — splitting the difference. You're at ten, they're at twelve: meet at eleven, nobody loses fully. But it only works when the gap is small. If the numbers are far apart, bring them closer first — the midpoint of a huge gap helps no one.
scenes.say_uz: 'Shall we meet halfway?' — farqni teng ikkiga bo‘lish. Siz o‘n, ular o‘n ikki: o‘n birdan uchrashing, hech kim to‘liq yutqazmaydi. Lekin bu faqat farq kichik bo‘lganda ishlaydi. Raqamlar uzoq bo‘lsa, avval yaqinlashtiring — katta farqning o‘rtasi hech kimga ma’qul emas.

scenes.title: Bottom line: qachon chiqib ketish kerak

examples.t: I'm afraid we can't accept that — we'll have to walk away from this one.
examples.uz: Afsuski, shu shart bizga to‘g‘ri kelmaydi — bu bitimdan chiqishimiz kerak.

scenes.say_native: Chegara — professionallik o‘lchovi. Taklif chiziqdan tushsa: 'I'm afraid we can't accept that' — muloyim, lekin aniq. Kerak bo‘lsa: 'We'll have to walk away from this one, but we hope to work together in the future.' Chiqib ketish qo‘pollik emas — bu o‘z chegarangizni hurmat qilish; ammo bir marta chiqib ketgach, qaytish qiyin.
scenes.say: Staying inside your limit is professionalism. If the offer drops below your line: 'I'm afraid we can't accept that.' If it's final: 'We'll have to walk away from this one, but we hope to work together in the future.' Walking away is not rude — it's self-respect, used once.
scenes.say_uz: Chegarangizdan chiqmaslik — professionallik. Agar taklif chiziqdan tushsa: 'I'm afraid we can't accept that.' Agar yakuniy bo‘lsa: 'We'll have to walk away from this one, but we hope to work together in the future.' Chiqib ketish — qo‘pollik emas, hurmat — faqat bir marta ishlatiladi.

scenes.title: Tinglash 1: bozorda narx muzokarasi
scenes.say_native: Birinchi tinglash — bozorda narx muzokarasi. Aziza televizor sotib olmoqda; sotuvchi boshlang‘ich narxni bir million ikki yuz ming so‘mda aytadi, Aziza yumshoq qarshi-taklif beradi, yon do‘kon narxini dalil qiladi va nihoyat naqd to‘lov evaziga yakuniy narxga kelishiladi. Diqqat bilan tinglang: har raqamni esda tuting — keyingi sahifada to‘rtta savol beriladi.
scenes.say: Seller: This TV is twelve hundred thousand sums, brand new. Aziza: That's a bit high for me. I saw a similar model for nine hundred thousand at the next shop. Seller: For you, eleven hundred thousand, and I'll include the wall bracket. Aziza: How about nine hundred fifty thousand, with the bracket? Seller: Nine hundred eighty thousand, final price. Aziza: If you can do nine hundred fifty, then I'll pay cash right now. Seller: Deal. Nine fifty, with the bracket. Aziza: Deal — let's shake on it.
scenes.say_uz: Sotuvchi: Bu televizor bir million ikki yuz ming so‘m, mutlaqo yangi. Aziza: Bu men uchun biroz qimmat. Yon do‘konda shunga o‘xshash modelni to‘qqiz yuz mingga ko‘rdim. Sotuvchi: Sizga o‘n bir yuz ming, va devor kronshteynini ham qo‘shaman. Aziza: To‘qqiz yuz ellik mingga qanday, kronshteyn bilan? Sotuvchi: To‘qqiz yuz sakson ming, oxirgi narx. Aziza: To‘qqiz yuz ellikka tushsangiz, naqd to‘layman. Sotuvchi: Kelishdik. To‘qqiz ellik, kronshteyn bilan. Aziza: Kelishdik — kelishuvni tasdiqlang.

scenes.title: Tinglash savollari 1
board: 3 Yakuniy narx va shart nima bo‘ldi?
scenes.say_native: To‘rt savol. Bir: sotuvchining boshlang‘ich narxi qancha edi? Ikki: Aziza chegirma uchun qanday dalil keltirdi? Uch: yakuniy narx qanday va qanday shart kelishildi? To‘rt: Aziza nima evaziga chegirma oldi? Javoblarni ichingizda qayd eting — keyingi sahifada tekshiramiz.
scenes.say: Four questions. One: what was the seller's opening price? Two: what argument did Aziza use? Three: what was the final price and condition? Four: what did Aziza give in exchange for the discount? Answers in your head.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rt savol. Bir: sotuvchining boshlang‘ich narxi qancha edi? Ikki: Aziza qanday dalil keltirdi? Uch: yakuniy narx va shart qanday bo‘ldi? To‘rt: Aziza nima evaziga chegirma oldi? Javoblarni ichingizda ayting.

scenes.title: Javoblar: tinglash 1
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir: boshlang‘ich narx bir million ikki yuz ming so‘m. Ikki: Aziza 'yon do‘konda shunga o‘xshash modelni to‘qqiz yuz mingga ko‘rdim' deb dalil keltirdi — raqobat dalili har doim ishlaydi. Uch: yakuniy narx — to‘qqiz yuz ellik ming so‘m, kronshteyn bepul. To‘rt: naqd to‘lov evaziga — klassik 'give and get': u tez to‘lov berdi, sotuvchi narxdan tushdi.
scenes.say: Answers. One: the opening price was one million two hundred thousand sums. Two: she quoted a similar model at nine hundred thousand in the next shop. Three: final price nine hundred and fifty thousand, wall bracket included free. Four: cash payment right now — give and get in action.
scenes.say_uz: Javoblar. Bir: boshlang‘ich narx bir million ikki yuz ming so‘m. Ikki: u yon do‘konda shunga o‘xshash modelni to‘qqiz yuz mingga ko‘rganini aytdi. Uch: yakuniy narx — to‘qqiz yuz ellik ming, kronshteyn bepul. To‘rt: naqd to‘lov evaziga — give and get.

scenes.title: Tinglash 2: yetkazib beruvchi bilan muzokara
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi tinglash — biznes muzokarasi. Jasur yetkazib beruvchi bilan ulgurj buyurtma shartlarini kelishmoqda: besh yuz dona hajm, birligiga narx, to‘lov muddati va yetkazib berish xarajati. U ketma-ket ikkita shartli taklifdan foydalanadi. Diqqat bilan tinglang va barcha raqamlarni esda tuting — keyingi sahifada savollar beriladi.
scenes.say: Supplier: Five hundred units — eighteen dollars each. Jasur: If you can do sixteen, then we can sign a year-long contract. Supplier: Sixteen is too low; how about seventeen, net-thirty? Jasur: If you agree to seventeen with free delivery, we accept, paying within thirty days. Supplier: Delivery included? That's usually extra. Jasur: If we commit to twelve months, you absorb the cost. Supplier: All right — seventeen, free delivery, net-thirty. Jasur: We have a deal. I'll confirm by email.
scenes.say_uz: Yetkazib beruvchi: Besh yuz dona uchun birligiga o‘n sakkiz dollar taklif qilamiz. Jasur: Rahmat. Agar o‘n olti dollarga tushsangiz, yillik shartnoma imzolaymiz. Yetkazib beruvchi: O‘n olti — juda kam; o‘n yetti, to‘lov o‘ttiz kun ichida? Jasur: Agar o‘n yettiga kelishib, yetkazib berishni bepul qilsangiz, qabul qilamiz — va o‘ttiz kun ichida to‘laymiz. Yetkazib beruvchi: Yetkazib berish bepul? Bu odatda birligiga ikki dollar qo‘shimcha. Jasur: Agar o‘n ikki oyga majburiyat olsak, yetkazib berish xarajati sizga qolsin. Yetkazib beruvchi: Yaxshi — o‘n yetti dollar, yetkazib berish bepul, to‘lov o‘ttiz kun, o‘n ikki oylik shartnoma. Jasur: Kelishdik. Bugunyoq shartlarni email bilan tasdiqlayman.

scenes.title: Tinglash savollari 2
board: 1 Birinchi taklif: narx va hajm qanday edi?
scenes.say_native: To‘rt savol. Bir: yetkazib beruvchining birinchi taklifi — narx va hajm qanday edi? Ikki: Jasurning birinchi shartli taklifida nima evaziga nima so‘radi? Uch: yakuniy shartlar nima bo‘ldi? To‘rt: kelishuv qanday tasdiqlandi? Javoblarni ichingizda ayting.
scenes.say: Four questions. One: what was the supplier's first offer — price and volume? Two: what was Jasur's first conditional proposal? Three: what were the final terms? Four: how was the deal confirmed? Answers in your head.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rt savol. Bir: yetkazib beruvchining birinchi taklifi — narx va hajm? Ikki: Jasurning birinchi shartli taklifi nima edi? Uch: yakuniy shartlar nima bo‘ldi? To‘rt: kelishuv qanday tasdiqlandi? Javoblarni ichingizda ayting.

scenes.title: Javoblar: tinglash 2
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir: boshlang‘ich taklif — besh yuz dona, birligiga o‘n sakkiz dollar. Ikki: Jasur yillik shartnoma evaziga o‘n olti dollarni so‘radi — 'If you can do sixteen, then we can sign a year-long contract'. Uch: yakuniy shartlar — birligiga o‘n yetti dollar, yetkazib berish bepul, to‘lov o‘ttiz kun ichida, o‘n ikki oylik shartnoma. To‘rt: Jasur kelishuvni o‘sha kuni email bilan yozma tasdiqlaymiz deb va’da berdi.
scenes.say: Answers. One: five hundred units at eighteen dollars each. Two: Jasur offered a twelve-month contract in exchange for sixteen per unit. Three: final terms — seventeen dollars, free delivery, net-thirty, twelve-month contract. Four: he promised written confirmation by email the same day.
scenes.say_uz: Javoblar. Bir: besh yuz dona, birligiga o‘n sakkiz dollar. Ikki: yillik shartnoma evaziga o‘n olti dollarni so‘radi. Uch: o‘n yetti dollar, yetkazib berish bepul, o‘ttiz kun, o‘n ikki oylik shartnoma. To‘rt: o‘sha kuni email bilan yozma tasdiqlash.

scenes.title: Muloyim norozilik: however bilan
board: 'I'm afraid that doesn't work for us.'

examples.t: I see your point; however, the price is still high for us.
examples.uz: Nuqtai nazaringizni tushunaman; ammo narx biz uchun hamon baland.

scenes.say_native: Norozilikni muloyim yetkazish 'however' bilan ulanadi: 'I see your point, however the price is still high for us'. 'I understand, but our budget simply can't stretch that far'. 'I'm afraid that doesn't work for us' — aniq, lekin hurmatli rad. E’tibor bering: norozilik tushunish bilan boshlanib, qarshilik bilan tugaydi — shunday qilsangiz, ikkinchi tomon eshitilganini his qiladi va kelishishga tayyor bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: Disagreement, politely: 'I see your point; however, the price is still high for us.' 'I understand, but our budget can't stretch that far.' 'I'm afraid that doesn't work for us.' Understanding first, objection second — the other side feels heard.
scenes.say_uz: Norozilik muloyimligi: 'I see your point; however, the price is still high for us.' 'I understand, but our budget can't stretch that far.' 'I'm afraid that doesn't work for us.' Avval tushunish, keyin e’tiroz — ikkinchi tomon eshitilganini his qiladi.

scenes.title: Yopish: shartlarni takrorlang

examples.t: Let me confirm: five hundred units at seventeen, free delivery, net-thirty.
examples.uz: Tasdiqlashimga ijozat: besh yuz dona, birligiga o‘n yetti, yetkazib berish bepul, o‘ttiz kun.

scenes.say_native: Kelishuvni yopishda uch qadam. Bir: shartlarni ovoz chiqarib takrorlang — narx, hajm, muddat, to‘lov. Ikki: 'We have a deal' yoki 'Let's shake on it' deb kelishuvni e’lon qiling. Uch: yozma tasdiqni va’da qiling — 'I'll put the terms in an email today'. Og‘zaki 'ha' bilan bitim yopilmaydi — keyin har bir tomon o‘zicha eslab qoladi va bahslash boshlanadi.
scenes.say: Three closing steps. One: repeat the terms aloud — price, volume, deadline, payment. Two: declare it — 'We have a deal' or 'Let's shake on it.' Three: promise written confirmation — 'I'll put the terms in an email today.' A verbal yes is not a closed deal.
scenes.say_uz: Yopishning uch qadami. Bir: shartlarni ovoz chiqarib takrorlang — narx, hajm, muddat, to‘lov. Ikki: e’lon qiling — 'We have a deal' yoki 'Let's shake on it.' Uch: yozma tasdiqni va’da qiling — 'I'll put the terms in an email today.' Og‘zaki ha — yopilgan bitim emas.

scenes.title: Namuna: kelishuvni yakunlash
scenes.say_native: Namuna yopilishni o‘qing: ikki tomon avval barcha shartlarni birma-bir sanab chiqadi, keyin kelishuvni e’lon qiladi, oxirida yozma tasdiq va’dasini beradi. Shunday yopilish tushunmovchiliklarni butunlay kamaytiradi va har ikki tomon bir xil kelishuvni eslab qoladi.
scenes.say: Let me confirm the terms: five hundred units at seventeen dollars, free delivery, payment within thirty days, twelve-month contract. Is that all correct? Then we have a deal. I'll email the written confirmation today, and the first order ships next Monday.
scenes.say_uz: Shartlarni tasdiqlashimga ijozat: besh yuz dona, birligiga o‘n yetti dollar, yetkazib berish bepul, to‘lov o‘ttiz kun ichida, o‘n ikki oylik shartnoma. Hammasi to‘g‘rimi? Unda kelishdik. Bugunyoq yozma tasdiqni emailga yuboraman, birinchi buyurtma keyingi dushanba jo‘natiladi.

scenes.title: Yozma tasdiq: kelishuvni biriktiring

examples.t: Just to confirm our agreement of today: 500 units at $17, net-30.
examples.uz: Bugungi kelishuvimizni tasdiqlab: 500 dona, birligiga $17, to‘lov 30 kun.

scenes.say_native: Har kelishuv yozma tasdiqlanishi shart. 'Just to confirm our agreement of today…' deb boshlang va narx, hajm, yetkazib berish, to‘lov muddati hamda har ikki tomonning javobini kiriting. Email — yozma dalil: telefon orqali kelishilgan hamma narsa emailga tushirilmasa, bir oydan keyin hech kim hech narsani aniq eslamaydi.
scenes.say: Every deal deserves written confirmation. Open with 'Just to confirm our agreement of today…' and list price, volume, delivery, payment terms and who does what. Email is the written proof — if the call isn't followed by an email, nobody remembers the same deal a month later.
scenes.say_uz: Har bitim yozma tasdiqqa loyiq. 'Just to confirm our agreement of today…' bilan boshlang va narx, hajm, yetkazib berish, to‘lov shartlarini, hamda kim nima qilishini sanang. Email — yozma dalil: qo‘ng‘iroq emailga aylanmasa, bir oydan keyin hech kim bir xil bitimni eslamaydi.

scenes.title: Muzokara ochilishini ayting
scenes.say_native: Muzokaraning ochilishini aytib bering. Vaziyat: ofis mebellari sotib olasiz — ellik ta stul kerak, byudjet yigirma ming dollar. 'We need…' bilan boshlang, byudjetingizni ayting, keyin shartli taklif qo‘shing: 'If you can include delivery and assembly, then we can sign today.' Ovoz chiqarib, o‘ttiz soniyada.
scenes.say: Speak the opening. You're buying office furniture — fifty chairs, budget twenty thousand dollars. Start with 'We need…', name the budget, finish with a conditional proposal: 'If you can include delivery and assembly, then we can sign today.' Thirty seconds.
scenes.say_uz: Ochilishni ayting. Ofis mebellari sotib olasiz — ellik stul, byudjet yigirma ming dollar. 'We need…' bilan boshlang, byudjetni ayting, shartli taklif bilan tugating: 'If you can include delivery and assembly, then we can sign today.' O‘ttiz soniya.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: weak forms va raqamlar
scenes.say_native: Muzokarada talaffuz ham qurol. 'Can I' tez aytganda 'kən aɪ' ga, 'could you' 'kʊdʒə' ga aylanadi — qisqa va silliq. Raqamlarni aytganda eng muhim so‘zga stress bering: 'eight thousand' — 'eight' kuchli. Va 'twenty' so‘zidagi 't' tovushi deyarli yo‘qoladi: 'twen-i'. Raqamlarni sekin va aniq ayting — muzokarada narx xatosi eng qimmat xatodir.
scenes.say: Pronunciation is a tool. 'Can I' reduces to 'kən aɪ'; 'could you' to 'kʊdʒə'. Put stress on the key word in numbers: EIGHT thousand. In 'twenty' the inner t nearly disappears — say 'twen-i'. Speak numbers slowly and clearly — a price mistake is the costliest mistake.
scenes.say_uz: Talaffuz ham qurol. 'Can I' — 'kən aɪ', 'could you' — 'kʊdʒə'. Raqamlarda asosiy so‘zga stress bering: EIGHT thousand. 'Twenty' dagi t tovushi deyarli yo‘qoladi — 'twen-i' deb ayting. Raqamlarni sekin va aniq ayting.

scenes.title: 6 tipik xato: o‘zbekcha ongdan
scenes.say_native: Olti xatoni tuzlang. Bir: 'Cheaper!' — bu buyruq, so‘rov emas; 'Could you offer a better price?' deb ayting. Ikki: 'I want discount' — 'Could we discuss a discount?' Uch: 'It is very expensive!' — bahs emas; 'That's a bit high for us' yetadi. To‘rt: 'No!' sababsiz yolg‘iz kelmaydi — 'No, because our budget is fixed'. Besh: 'a lot of money' o‘rniga har doim aniq raqam. Oltinchi: ketishdan oldin hech bo‘lmasa oxirgi taklifni so‘rang — 'Is that your best offer?'
scenes.say: Fix six habits. 'Cheaper!' is an order — say 'Could you offer a better price?' 'I want discount' becomes 'Could we discuss a discount?' 'It is very expensive!' becomes 'That's a bit high for us.' 'No!' needs its reason. 'A lot of money' becomes a precise figure. Always ask 'Is that your best offer?' before walking away.
scenes.say_uz: Olti odatni tuzlang. 'Cheaper!' — buyruq; 'Could you offer a better price?' deb ayting. 'I want discount' — 'Could we discuss a discount?' 'It is very expensive!' — 'That's a bit high for us.' 'No!' — sababi bilan. 'A lot of money' — aniq raqam. Ketishdan oldin 'Is that your best offer?' deb so‘rang.

scenes.title: Xato → To‘g‘ri: muloyim so‘roqlar
scenes.say_native: Xatolarni tuzating. 'Make it cheaper' — buyruq; to‘g‘ri variant: 'Could you offer a better price?' 'I want ten percent off' — talab; to‘g‘ri variant: 'Would ten percent be possible?' Qat’iy gaplar muzokarada devor; yumshoq so‘roqlar eshik. Inglizcha muzokarada ohang kuchgandan muhimroq — xato buyruq emas, ohangdagi buyruq ohangidir.
scenes.say: Fix the register. 'Make it cheaper' is an order — say 'Could you offer a better price?' 'I want ten percent off' is a demand — say 'Would ten percent be possible?' Hard sentences build walls in negotiation; soft questions open doors.
scenes.say_uz: Registrni tuzlang. 'Make it cheaper' — buyruq; 'Could you offer a better price?' deb ayting. 'I want ten percent off' — talab; 'Would ten percent be possible?' deb ayting. Qattiq jumlalar devor quradi; yumshoq so‘roqlar eshik ochadi.

scenes.title: Xatolarni inglizchaga o‘giring
scenes.say_native: Uchta xatoni inglizchaga to‘g‘rilang. 'Cheaper!' qanday muloyim so‘roqqa aylanadi? 'I want discount' qanday taklifga aylanadi? 'No!' qanday sababli radga aylanadi? Har birini ovoz chiqarib ayting va ohangingiz muloyimligiga e’tibor bering — yigirma besh soniya.
scenes.say: Turn three blunt lines into polite English. How does 'Cheaper!' become a question? How does 'I want discount' become a proposal? How does 'No!' become a reasoned refusal? Out loud, twenty-five seconds.
scenes.say_uz: Uchta qo‘pol iborani muloyim inglizchaga aylantiring. 'Cheaper!' qanday so‘roqqa aylanadi? 'I want discount' qanday taklifga aylanadi? 'No!' qanday asosli radga aylanadi? Ovoz chiqarib — yigirma besh soniya.

scenes.title: Muddat bosimi: muloyim ultimatum
board: 'Could you let us know by Friday?'

examples.t: We'd appreciate an answer by Thursday 17:00.
examples.uz: Payshanba soat 17:00 gacha javob bersangiz, mamnun bo‘lamiz.

scenes.say_native: Muddatni talab emas, iltimos sifatida ayting: 'Could you let us know by Friday?' yoki 'We'd appreciate an answer by the 15th'. 'We need it now!' kabi bosim inglizchada ham qo‘pol — hech qanday muzokarada yordam bermaydi. Muddat berish normal; bosim bilan berish noto‘g‘ri. Muddat har doim aniq sana va soat bilan: 'by Friday', 'by 17:00', 'by end of week'.
scenes.say: Deadlines are fine — pressure is not. 'Could you let us know by Friday?' 'We'd appreciate an answer by the 15th.' 'We need it now!' is rude in any language and helps no negotiation. Always attach a specific date or time — never a vague 'soon'.
scenes.say_uz: Muddat yaxshi — bosim yomon. 'Could you let us know by Friday?' 'We'd appreciate an answer by the 15th.' 'We need it now!' — aloqasiz va yordamsiz. Har doim aniq sana va soat qo‘ying — mavhum 'soon' emas.

scenes.title: To‘liq muzokarani o‘ynang
scenes.say_native: Endi to‘liq muzokarani ovoz chiqarib aytib bering. Vaziyat: siz logistika firmasiga yuk tashish xizmatini sotyapsiz — Toshkentdan Samarqandga, oyiga o‘ttiz yuk. Tayyorlang: 'We need…' deb oching; o‘rtada qarshi-taklif va shartli ibora ishlating; yakunda shartlarni takrorlab, 'We have a deal' deb yoping va yozma tasdiqni va’da qiling. Qirq soniya.
scenes.say: Act out the whole negotiation. You sell freight services — Tashkent to Samarkand, thirty shipments a month. Open with 'We need…', use a counter-offer and an 'if…then' line in the middle, then recap the terms and close with 'We have a deal' plus written confirmation. Forty seconds.
scenes.say_uz: Butun muzokarani o‘ynang. Yuk tashish xizmati sotasiz — Toshkentdan Samarqandga, oyiga o‘ttiz yuk. 'We need…' bilan oching, o‘rtada qarshi-taklif va 'if…then' qatordan foydalaning, yakunda shartlarni takrorlab 'We have a deal' deb yoping va yozma tasdiqni va’da qiling. Qirq soniya.

scenes.title: Bugungi darsning xulosasi
board: Give and get — bosh hisobsiz yon bermang
scenes.say_native: Xulosa: ehtiyojni aniq raqam va muddat bilan ayting — 'We need…'. Taklif va qarshi-takliflar — 'Could you do…?', 'How about…?'. Shartli taklif — 'If you can…, then we can…'. Hech qachon bosh hisobsiz yon bermang — har doim evaziga nimadir oling. Bitimni 'We have a deal' bilan yopib, albatta yozma tasdiqlang.
scenes.say: In short: needs in numbers and dates — 'We need…'. Offers and counters — 'Could you do…?', 'How about…?' Conditionals — 'If you can…, then we can…'. Give and get on every concession. Close with 'We have a deal' and confirm everything in writing.
scenes.say_uz: Xulosa: ehtiyojni raqam va sana bilan — 'We need…'. Taklif va qarshi-taklif — 'Could you do…?', 'How about…?' Shartli — 'If you can…, then we can…'. Har yon berishda give and get. Yakun — 'We have a deal' + yozma tasdiq.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi va keyingi dars
board: Keyingi dars: Sayohat — aeroport va mehmonxona
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: yozma dialogda narx muzokara qiling — ikki kishi o‘rtasida kamida olti replika: ehtiyoj, taklif, qarshi-taklif, shartli ibora, 'give and get' almashinuvi va yakuniy kelishuv. Har replikani inglizchada yozib, dialoogni ovoz chiqarib o‘qing. Keyingi darsda sayohatni o‘rganamiz — aeroport va mehmonxona: check-in, xavfsizlik, yo‘qolgan yuk va mehmonxona shikoyatlari. Omad tilayman!
scenes.say: Homework: write a price-negotiation dialogue of at least six turns — need, offer, counter, conditional, give-and-get, closing — then read it aloud. Next lesson: travel — airports and hotels, including lost luggage and complaints. Good luck!
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifasi: narx muzokarasi dialogini yozing — kamida olti replika: ehtiyoj, taklif, qarshi-taklif, shartli ibora, give and get va yakun — keyin ovoz chiqarib o‘qing. Keyingi dars: sayohat — aeroport va mehmonxona. Omad tilayman!

quiz.q: Which sentence states a need professionally?
options: We maybe want some chairs someday.
We need two hundred chairs by 15 June; our budget is about eight thousand dollars.
quiz.why_uz: Ehtiyoj aniq miqdor, sana va byudjet bilan aytiladi — 'maybe' va umumiy gaplar ishonchsizlik belgisidir.

quiz.q: What does 'bottom line' mean in a negotiation?
options: the first sentence of a contract
the bottom edge of an invoice
quiz.why_uz: Bottom line — bundan pastga tushilmaydigan oxirgi pozitsiya; muzokarachining ichki chegarasi.

quiz.q: Which of these is a counter-offer?
quiz.why_uz: Qarshi-taklif — raqam yoki shart bilan javob: 'Could you do…?' — sizning narxingizni aniq aytadi.

quiz.q: Which sentence is a conditional proposal?
options: If you can deliver by Friday, then we can pay in advance.
We want a very big discount.
quiz.why_uz: Shartli taklifda shart birinchi, natija keyin: 'If you can…, then we can…' — ikki tomon aniq majburiyat oladi.

options: meet at the station halfway to town
split the difference between two numbers
quiz.why_uz: Meet halfway — farqni teng ikkiga bo‘lish: siz o‘n, ular o‘n ikki — o‘n birdan uchrashish.

quiz.q: What is the 'give and get' rule?
options: Never concede without asking for something in return
quiz.why_uz: Har yon berish evaziga nimadir oling — tez to‘lov, hajm yoki uzoq shartnoma; bir tomonli yon berish zaiflik alomati.

quiz.q: Which phrase formally closes a deal?
quiz.why_uz: 'We have a deal' — kelishuvni aniq e’lon qilish; undan keyin shartlar takrorlanadi va yozma tasdiq yuboriladi.

quiz.q: After agreeing verbally, what should you do?
options: Wait for the other side to write
Send a written confirmation of the terms
quiz.why_uz: Og‘zaki kelishuv — xotiralar bo‘yicha bahslash manbai; email tasdiq — yozma dalil.

quiz.q: Which is a polite refusal at your bottom line?
options: I'm afraid we can't accept that.
quiz.why_uz: 'I'm afraid we can't accept that' — muloyim, lekin qat’iy; chegarangizni hurmat bilan bildiradi.

quiz.q: Why avoid saying 'It is very expensive!'?
options: It puts the other side on the defensive instead of quoting your number
quiz.why_uz: Hissiyotli gaplar tomonlarni himoyaga o‘tkazadi; raqam bilan ayting: 'That's a bit high for us'.
